patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Blocks Segment and Mux events, disables Firebase Analytics after consent updates, denies automatic Crashlytics uploads and selects disabled Datadog setup. SDK initialization, queued Segment events, local metadata, Firebase collection before consent updates, local crash recording and explicit report submission remain; independent Braze and Singular behavior is unchanged.

patches.name: Proxy token requests
patches.description: Routes token acquisition and refresh through your SOCKS proxy, with optional proxy authentication.

options.title: SOCKS proxy host
options.description: Hostname or IP address only, without scheme, credentials, or port. Use brackets for IPv6.

options.title: SOCKS proxy port
options.description: Explicit port from 1 to 65535. Enter as a string when using a JSON options file.

options.title: SOCKS proxy username
options.description: Optional printable ASCII username (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Leave both credential fields blank for no authentication.

options.title: SOCKS proxy password
options.description: Optional printable ASCII password (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Supply both username and password together.

options.title: Local token diagnostics
options.description: Logs token HTTP status and exception class names only, under MorpheTokenProxy. Enable for troubleshooting.
